Thanks for contributing to SPFN! Keep PRs focused on one concern.

## Summary

<!-- What does this PR change, and why? -->

## Related issue

<!-- e.g. Closes #123 -->

## Type of change

- [ ] feat — new functionality
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] docs — documentation only
- [ ] refactor / chore — no behavior change
- [ ] breaking change (`!`)

## Checklist

- [ ] PR addresses a single concern
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] Routes changed? Ran `pnpm codegen` and committed the regenerated output
- [ ] Schema changed? Ran `pnpm db:generate` and committed the migration
- [ ] Updated the relevant `packages/<name>/README.md` for any public behavior change
- [ ] Commits use Conventional Commit messages
- [ ] All commits are signed off (DCO): `git commit -s`
- [ ] I understand and take responsibility for this change, including any
      AI-generated code
